representations.name: two-sided second-support gaps
representations.new_information: Retains the first interior support layer measured from each natural endpoint.
representations.first_test: Define g_-,g_+ on every non-singleton positive mask and test translation invariance.

representations.name: width-gap tropical triple
representations.new_information: Packages width with both endpoint gaps so positive products have an exact sum/min/min rule.
representations.first_test: Prove the second distinct point of A+B is the earlier of a1+b0 and a0+b1.

representations.name: projective source gap pair
representations.new_information: Normalizes endpoint gaps by width to quotient both translation and positive scale.
representations.first_test: Compute the pair for lambda X under both scalar signs and record reflection.

representations.name: four-branch sign-anchor table
representations.new_information: Separates positive/negative signs from zero/nonzero endpoint anchors without changing order.
representations.first_test: Verify endpoint gaps depend on sign but not on whether either endpoint equals zero.

representations.name: common-spectrum tropical censor
representations.new_information: Turns P_V=P_Aj P_(lambda_jX) into min equations for both unknown complement boundary gaps.
representations.first_test: Classify source gap below, equal to, or above the fixed V gap.

representations.name: exceptional equality ledger
representations.new_information: Counts rows where a distinct scalar-copy gap hits exactly one common-spectrum endpoint gap.
representations.first_test: Use same-sign distinct absolute scalars to bound each equality set by one.

representations.name: two-sided retained core
representations.new_information: Uses both feasibility thresholds to delete at most one equality-wall row and retain a power-large core with both complement gaps forced.
representations.first_test: Prove size at least |J_sigma|-1 and exact constant complement profile.

representations.name: literal versus residual shape ledger
representations.new_information: Separates injective raw source gaps from constant normalized source shape and newly forced complement gaps.
representations.first_test: Count each range on the same retained core.

representations.name: higher support-layer stress test
representations.new_information: Tests whether third and later gaps obey the same coordinatewise minimum law.
representations.first_test: Construct positive sets whose third Minkowski layer is a mixed sum rather than one input layer.

representations.name: global distance firewall
representations.new_information: Keeps local boundary rigidity separate from target occurrence, collision fibres and outer stability.
representations.first_test: Require all three global inequalities before an exponent claim.
